infobox.usage: Unlocks door 306 in the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 306 key (Dorm 306) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "306" on it.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Currency)
- Poster (Posters)
- Possible Rare weapon spawn (HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle or FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle or Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle)
